characterExport.name: Idle
characterExport.prompt:
A middle-aged anthropomorphic tiger martial artist who was once
large and powerful. His sturdy build has softened with age and
modest weight gain, giving him a gentler, more easygoing presence.

Warm orange fur with black tiger stripes, a cream-white muzzle
and fluffy cheek tufts, rounded ears, and a striped orange tail.
Relaxed half-closed eyes, soft eyebrows, and a mellow smile.
He has mild alcohol dependence and a subtly tipsy expression.

He wears an open reddish-brown martial-arts jacket with long
sleeves, a cream wraparound inner shirt, a brown waist sash tied
in a knot, and loose dark charcoal trousers. His striped tiger
hands and feet are bare.

Low-resolution RPG pixel art with crisp stepped edges, thin dark
outlines, clear pixel clusters, and simple restrained shading.

Preserve the reference sprite's exact head-to-body proportions,
silhouette, facial features, stripe patterns, clothing, and palette
consistently across all rotations. Keep age, weight gain, and
tipsiness subtle.

playback.origin: 라이브러리 비교 설정. 서비스의 원본 재생 시간은 미확인.
playback.pivot: 동일 동작·방향은 원본 캔버스 중심과 모든 프레임의 최하단 알파 위치를 공통 기준으로 사용. 개별 프레임을 재배치·확대·크롭하지 않음.
playback.grabTiming: 잡기 4클립은 중심 지지80ms, 던짐20~30ms, 바닥 접촉 정지140ms, 회수25~60ms, 마무리300ms로 재배분했다.
